address: Longueville Road, Saint Saviour, JE2 7WF, United Kingdom
bio: Set within a charming manor house; dine in the characterful 15C oak-panelled room, the brighter Garden Room or on the terrace – and make sure you ask to see their impressive wine cellar. Daily menus champion island produce; seafood is a feature and many ingredients come from the impressive kitchen garden. Classic dishes have a modern edge; save room for some cheese from the trolley....
